editorial:
Imagine trying to decorate for Christmas and accidentally chopping your best friend's head off with a machete. That is exactly how things kick off for Rich, a total goofball who finds himself in the worst possible situation. To fix his huge mistake, he has to go on a wild journey to find God's bong, which is the only thing powerful enough to bring Benny back to life. Along the way, you get to meet some weird characters like Az the Demon and Boogar, making the whole trip feel like one big, trippy fever dream. It is a crazy mix of gore and laughs that does not take itself seriously at all.

What really works here is the chemistry between the characters and the sheer absurdity of the plot. The pacing is quick, though some parts feel a bit random, but that just adds to the charm. If you love movies that are completely off the wall, you will have a blast with this one. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a collector of weird cinema, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: After a wild ride, Rich finally manages to use God's bong to reverse the disaster. The magic works, and Benny is brought back to life, though he is not exactly the same as before. The movie wraps up with the duo safe and sound, having learned a very hard lesson about using machetes around Christmas trees. It ends on a light note, proving that friendship can survive even the craziest supernatural mishaps.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves absurd humor and low-budget horror.
